title: Confirming a Change of Covered Value on a Pass and Trip Protection Plan
content:
Where the value a Pass and Trip Protection plan carries as covered is to be brought onto the price the
collective's record shows for the covered holding, the plan is rewritten to cover that holding at the recorded
value and to carry the premium that goes with it. The household itself makes that confirmation on the plan it
holds, and once it is made the plan shows the new covered value and the new premium whenever it is read back.
Nothing else on the plan moves: the plan keeps its state, its dates, its insured, the holding it is written
over and the cover already loaded for the season.

**How the confirmation is made.** The tool `confirm_plan_value_amendment_50d33fe4` is a tool of the
household's own. The desk unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it on their own plan.

**What is passed to it.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `protection_plan_id` | The reference number of the single protection plan the household is confirming the change on, as the protection plan lookup returns it for this household | The reference as the lookup returns it |
| `covered_value_usd` | The value the plan is to cover, in USD | A plain number to 2 decimal places, such as 1234.56, with no currency symbol and no thousands separator; it is stored to the cent exactly as passed |
| `repriced_premium_usd` | The premium the plan is to carry, in USD | A plain number to 2 decimal places, such as 123.45, with no currency symbol and no thousands separator; it is stored to the cent exactly as passed |

**What comes back.** A single line of confirmation text naming the protection plan reference, the covered
value now standing on the plan in USD to the cent, and the premium now standing on the plan in USD to the
cent. The line beginning with the word Confirmed is the receipt that the change was written; any other wording
means the plan was not rewritten.
